components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Text navigation with 44px targets and an expanding olive underline for hover, focus, and the current page.
components.html: HomeWritingNotesAbout
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif;line-height:1.65;display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:14px}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:8px 0;color:var(--muted,#72736a);text-decoration:none;transition:color 80ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset-inline:0;bottom:6px;height:1.5px;background:var(--accent,#526640);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:is(:hover,:focus-visible,[aria-current='page']){color:var(--ink,#2b2d28)}.ds-nav a:is(:hover,:focus-visible,[aria-current='page'])::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#526640);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:2px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{gap:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a,.ds-nav a::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A simple, understated, slightly modern personal website, informed by Steph Ango’s reading-focused site. Warm paper, dark type, generous margins, and a restrained olive accent keep attention on the writing. The visual structure comes from typography, whitespace, and plain lists.

Typography, spacing, and motion refinements take inspiration from design.how’s Lime foundations. Their application here is original CSS adapted for reading; no external components or runtime were added.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals with small olive details.
Flat surfaces and fine horizontal rules.
Familiar text links and restrained state changes.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Use olive for small reading and interaction cues; keep the page’s large surfaces paper-colored.

dos: Do preserve the narrow reading measure and responsive gutters.
Do distinguish reading hierarchy through type, spacing, and fine rules.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a marketing hero or portfolio/work-history cards.
Don't turn lists or topics into raised cards or filled pills.
Don't add decorative shadows, large accent surfaces, or an unrelated display font.
